{{Quote|Those clankers have tough armor!|[[Cody/Legends|Commander Cody]], on the durability of the BX-series|audio=ToughArmor-Rookies.flac|<ref name="TCWRookies" />}}
The '''BX-series droid commando''', more commonly known as the '''commando droid''', was an elite [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model made for stealth assignments.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Welcome to Rishi&hellip;Commander. As&hellip;you can see, the outpost is operating at&hellip;peak efficiency. Thank you for visiting&hellip;and have a&hellip;safe trip&hellip;back.|A droid commando trying to imitate a clone trooper|audio=BXCommandoImitatesClone-Rookies.flac|<ref name="TCWRookies" />}}
[[File:CoolWatch.jpg|thumb|left|A Droid Commando uses a [[repulsorcam]] to spy on a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]]]]
These [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] appeared to be similar in general design to the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] series, but with a noticeably different head shape and larger, white photoreceptors . Their voices were notably different compared to the B1 series, sounding more akin to the deep voices of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]]. Unit leaders, which held the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]], were fitted with white marks on their brows and chestplates and frequently wielded a vibrosword.<ref name="TCWRookies" />

They had the same operating abilities as B1 battle droids, with the addition of infiltration software.<ref name="TCWCG" /> This, along with their [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] shape, allowed them to fit into a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper's]] [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]]. In addition to this, the droids were capable of modulating their voices to match that of others, though they could not accurately copy their mannerisms or vocabulary, nor respond properly to unexpected situations outside of combat.<ref name="TCWRookies" />

The droid [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] were built to be substantially faster and stronger than a regular battle droid, and also possessed heavier armor capable of withstanding multiple shots from most [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. Sustained barrages or a single headshot could overwhelm them, but there are observed instances of bisected droids remaining semi-operable until dispatched by further damage, similar to super battle droids and [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]]; Eeth Koth cut a BX-series model in half, but it remained functional until Koth rendered it inoperable by piercing its head with his lightsaber.<ref name="TCWRookies" /> The head, generally, appears to have been a weak point; Senator Padme Amidala destroyed a BX with a headshot while wielding an [[ELG-3A blaster pistol/Legends|ELG-3A royal blaster pistol]], hardly bigger than a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]]. The only real drawback of these droids was that they were far more expensive to produce than the regular infantry. This made the droids a fairly rare sight on the battlefield, instead used almost exclusively on special operations missions and high importance tasks. 

[[File:CommandoDroids-SWE.png|thumb|right|229x229px|Three commando droids wielding blaster rifles.]]
The BX-series commando droid wielded a variety of weapons, depending on the operation, including: [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifles]], a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]], and a [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusioncutter]]; additionally, the leader of a droid commando unit often carried a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] for close-combat purposes. They were also known to use [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] against enemy emplacements. Demonstrating the variety of roles the type was utilized in, a two-droid team of BX droids were observed on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] acting as a marksman team; one shooter with a [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] and one spotter using [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]].<ref name="TCWRookies" />

==History==
===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Well... at least they're not destroyer droids.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] after being ambushed by droid commandos|<ref name="GI">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref>}}
[[File:Droidcommandosword.jpg|left|thumb|186x186px|A [[Sparky/Legends|commando droid captain]] with a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]].]]
BX-series droid commandos were designed to accomplish tasks that an overwhelming force of droids could not.<ref name="TCWCG" /> Captain Rex and Commander Cody both defeated droid commandos in combat on the [[Rishi moon]], and the clone deserter, Cut Lawquane, managed to defeat a force of almost two dozen Commando droids with only minimal assistance from Captain Rex on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], although the droids they fought were heavily damaged. They were capable of hand-to-hand combat, had greater accuracy with their E-5 carbines than the line B1 model, and possessed familiarity with a variety of close and long-range combat arms. However, due to their prohibitive cost, they could not be mass-produced in such a manner as to replace the Confederacy's other battle droids, relegating them to special operations, boarding parties, and raids.<ref name="Videocommentary#5">{{SW|url=video/rookies-episode-featurette|text="Rookies" Episode Featurette}}</ref> A commando droid once crossed paths with a [[Unidentified Bith Jedi Scholar|Bith Jedi Scholar]] in a jungle, where the Jedi used [[Plant Surge]] to constrict the droid.<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>

===Battle of the Rishi Moon===
{{Quote|The outpost is secure, General. We shut down the alarm and turned on the all-clear signal.|A droid commando reporting the capture of the listening post to General Grievous|audio=OutpostIsSecure-Rookies.flac|<ref name="TCWRookies" />}}
[[File:DroidCommandos-Rookies.png|thumb|right|250px|Droid commandos prepare to execute Sergeant O'Niner]]
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="tcwn">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]], planned to invade the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], where the Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were grown. In order to invade the planet unnoticed, Grievous sent several [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ships]] containing BX-series droid commandos to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], where a Republic [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]], the [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]] was located. The [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] stationed on the listening post identified the boarding [[Starship/Legends|ships]] as a meteor shower, and did not alert a nearby Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. The droids caught the deck officer, [[CT-327/Legends|CT-327]], by surprise, stunning and killing him. They then [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|infiltrated]] the listening post, but were met by two clones, [[Droidbait/Legends|Droidbait]] and [[Nub/Legends|Nub]], who had been sent by [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[O'Niner/Legends|O'Niner]] to find out why CT-327 did not reply. Upon hearing weapons fire, the remaining clones rushed to help, but were outnumbered by the commando droids. O'Niner/ was also killed by the commandos in the ensuing firefight. However, four clone troopers were able to escape the station through a ventilation shaft. The droids then secured the post and jammed the all-clear signal.<ref name="TCWRookies" />

The droid commandos, however, were not aware that a routine inspection of the station conducted by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] was on its way. Upon arriving in the [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] [[Obex/Legends|''Obex'']], the two clone [[Officer/Legends|officers]] were greeted by a commando droid dressed in a [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|clone armor]]. The droid tried to convince the clone troopers to leave the listening post; however, Rex saw a droid attack flare fired from the survivors. Realizing the trick, he shot the disguised droid through the head. The commando droids then launched an ambush, and after throwing [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] toward the clones and destroying [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the droids believed that the two had [[Death/Legends|died]] in the explosion. In fact, Cody and Rex had survived with the help of their harpoon cables. Meeting the survivors of the first droid assault below the station, the officers introduced themselves and a plot to retake the station was developed. Rex used a droid commando head to cheat the droids within the station to open the door. The clones then stormed the station, eventually regaining control of the control center after killing the commandos, including the droid captain. Despite reinforcements sent by General Grievous, the clone troopers blew up the station, cutting off the all-clear signal, thus alerting the Republic fleet of the planned Confederate invasion.<ref name="TCWRookies" />

===Ambush on Kynachi===
[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] and his squad, called [[Breakout Squad]], fought three of these units on a mission on the planet [[Kynachi]].

===Battle of Ryloth===
During the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], at least two droid commandos were present in the capital city of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]]. The two attacked the [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|ARF troopers]] [[Razor/Legends|Razor]] and [[Stak/Legends|Stak]], shortly after the two troopers activated the plasma bridge and allowed Republic forces to enter the city. Even using fellow [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] as projectiles, they eschewed the use of blasters and engaged the two troopers in hand-to-hand combat, but were soon defeated.<ref name="TCWLiberty">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>

===Senate Hostage Crisis===
Later on, [[Unidentified BX-series droid commando 1 (Cad Bane)/Legends|two of]] [[Unidentified BX-series droid commando 2 (Cad Bane)/Legends|these units]] were used by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] during his [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|capture]] of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. After killing a contingent of [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]] that guarded the landing area, the two BX-series droids stripped two bodies of their armor and disguised themselves as the commandos. They later escaped with [[Cad Bane/Legends|Bane]], [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] and the other [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]].<ref name="TCWHostage">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref>

They were also deployed during the [[Battle of Tirahnn (Clone Wars)|Battle of Tirahnn]].<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

===Battle of Saleucami===
[[File:Saleucami_forest.png|thumb|left|250px|Commando droids sniping in the Saleucami wetlands]]
A squad of such commando droids accompanied General Grievous when he boarded [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth's]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]. The droids [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|defeated]] the Jedi's clone trooper guards but were destroyed by Koth. Later, during a rescue attempt conducted by the Jedi to rescue Master Koth, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] was boarded and its crew was assaulted by BX-series droids. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] found a squad of commando droids, commanded by [[TV-94/Legends|TV-94]], guarding Koth when they boarded Grievous's flagship. Skywalker and Gallia destroyed all of the droids and rescued Koth.<ref name="GI" />

Later during the [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|Battle of Saleucami]], Grievous's forces were forced to crash land onto the planet [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] where a pair of commando droids serving as a sniper unit were operational. The droid spotter observed the arrival of [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] whereupon the sniper took a shot that wounded the target. However, the sniper pair was tracked down and killed by Rex's comrades. While Rex recuperated at [[Lawquane farmstead|Cut Lawquane's farm]], another squad of heavily damaged BX-series droids were in an escape pod that crashed into the fields of the farm, and were accidentally reactivated by Cut's adopted children [[Shaeeah Lawquane/Legends|Shaeeah]] and [[Jek Lawquane/Legends|Jek]]. The droids attacked the farm and despite their heavy damage were able to pin down and nearly overwhelm its defenders. After a hard fought battle and close call they were destroyed by Lawquane and Rex.<ref name="TD">{{TCW|The Deserter}}</ref>

===Citadel Escape===
[[File:Commando_droid_personal_shield.png|thumb|right|250px|Commando droids with hand-held personal energy shields]]
In the Confederacy prison [[The Citadel (episode)|the Citadel]], Warden [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]] had a team of these commandos painted with a special yellow color scheme. One of these droids was seen torturing Jedi Master [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] for information on the Nexus Route with an [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]], while an [[Unidentified EV-series interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droid]] questioned Piell. Many of them carried [[Droid commando personal shield/Legends|hand-held energy shields]]. One of them was responsible for the apparent [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC Trooper]] [[Echo/Legends|Echo]]. A [[Unidentified BX-series droid commando captain (Citadel)/Legends|droid commando captain]] was also forced to destroy one of [[Unidentified BX-series droid commando (disambiguation)|his own droids]] after the Citadel [[Warden/Legends|warden]] [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]] ordered him to do so for displeasing him.

===Reinforcements on Felucia===
A reinforcement battalion was sent to strengthen the position on a Separatist outpost to prevent Republic victory deep in Confederate territory of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. Commando droids were present in this group, and shortly after the deployment of the reinforcments, the outpost commanded by [[TZ-33/Legends|TZ-33]] came under fire by Republic [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TEs]]. TZ-33 then ordered all units to form up for a counterattack, thereby lowering the outpost gate; this order proved to be the outpost's downfall as the Republic clones of [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]]&mdash;led by Anakin Skywalker, [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Rex, and [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]]&mdash;then attacked the droid outpost, destroying all the droids, including the commando droids. Although the Separatists did not win, Tano was captured by a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] sport hunter by the name of [[Lo-Taren/Legends|Lo-Taren]].

===Skirmish on Naboo===
[[File:BX-seriesDroidCaptain-TCW.png|thumb|left|150px|An unarmed BX commando with the markings of a captain]]
Just before the [[Skirmish on Naboo/Legends|Skirmish on Naboo]], commando droids were deployed by [[Minister]] [[Rish Loo/Legends|Rish Loo]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] after [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Lyonie/Legends|Lyonie]] confronted him after discovering that Rish Loo was a traitor. In the fight that followed, all of the commando droids were destroyed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Amidala, while Loo stabbed Lyonie and fled the underwater city where the fight took place.

===Battle of Kiros===
Several droid commandos were present during the Separatist occupation of the planet [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]]. When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] came to [[Battle of Kiros|liberate]] Kiros, a group of droid commandos on speeders ambushed a clone party led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. While the clones took some casualties, all the commandos were ultimately destroyed. Two units were also guarding the Separatist commander in-charge of the occupation, [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]]. However, they were also destroyed when Kenobi arrived.

===Battle of Dathomir===
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] ordered [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to eliminate [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], together with the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Grievous began his [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|invasion of Dathomir]], where he deployed several BX-series battle droids, together with [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]], one [[Defoliator/Legends|Defoliator tank]] and other forces. One of the BX-series droids used a [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]] to destroy the wall of the cave, in which Talzin and Old [[Daka/Legends|Daka]] tried to kill Dooku via Nightsister magic. Grievous managed to eliminate Old Daka and a Nightsister, while Talzin disappeared. The BX-series droid emptied the cauldron, and Dooku survived.

===Battle of Onderon===
A number of BX-series droid commandos were present on the planet [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] where they served under the [[Super tactical droid/Legends|super tactical droid]] [[Kalani/Legends|Kalani]], who was dispatched to defeat a [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|local rebellion]] brought against the Confederacy. These droid commandos were among the forces battling the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderonian rebels]], where they were ultimately defeated due to the armaments and training the rebels had received from the Republic. When the [[Royal Onderon Militia/Legends|Royal Onderon Militia]] abandoned [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] to fight for the rebels, BX-series droid commandos replaced them as his bodyguards until the Separatists withdrew from the planet and Rash was executed by Kalani.

===Ringo Vinda===
BX-series droid commandos (at least some with markings designating the rank of captain) served at the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|Battle of Ringo Vinda]] fighting the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], taking several casualties during the fighting. Later in the battle, defective [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Tup/Legends|Tup]] was abducted aboard a [[Maxillipede shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. Several droid commandos guarded Tup until [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Fives/Legends|Fives]], and [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] infiltrated [[Kraken's Maxillipede shuttle/Legends|Kraken's Maxillipede shuttle]] and destroyed the entire contingent.
